title: Global-sections acyclicity of the direct image of a K-injective
statement: For any scheme morphism f:X→Y [def-pc-scheme] and K-injective cochain complex I of O_X-modules [lem-sc-kinjective-quasi-iso-comparison], the right-derived unit for global sections on Y [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] evaluated at the homotopy-category image of f_*I is an isomorphism. The derived categories of O_Y-modules and Γ(Y,O_Y)-modules may have independent universes. There are no boundedness or qcqs hypotheses.

source.place: Tags 079W and 0D5T; applied to the global-sections point of Tag 0B6A

proof.text: Let p_Y:Y→(pt,Γ(Y,O_Y)) be the constructed global-sections point morphism. Apply the successive-direct-image acyclicity theorem to f and p_Y, choosing the standard derived category of module sheaves on the point. The unit for p_Y direct image is invertible at f_*I.

Evaluation on the point is an exact equivalence to Γ(Y,O_Y)-modules. Its composite with p_Y direct image is global sections, including the scalar action. The right-derived universal property gives the comparison compatible with the units. Applying the derived equivalence to the invertible unit from step 1, and conjugating by these comparison isomorphisms, proves the displayed global-sections unit invertible. No qcqs or boundedness condition is needed; for the identity morphism this reduces to the usual unit isomorphism on a K-injective, and for the zero complex all objects and maps are zero.

proof_origin.place: Tags 079W, 0D5T and the exact equivalence of modules on the global-sections point, Tag 0B6A

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_directImage_globalSections_unit_on_kInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    IsIso ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
          (.up ℤ)).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
